item.title: Is Nepal's flood a harbinger of what's to come in the Himalayas?
item.description: Building dams and hydropower plants in the Himalayas holds great promise for providing electricity. In the wake of the Nepal disaster, experts are asking about the risks of such construction.

item.title: Dems have an edge over GOP, poll finds. And, ICE looks into 'mobile detention centers'

item.title: A journalist once barred from the White House says this media ban is different
item.description: Jim Acosta has already been through a White House press-pass fight. Now, three news organizations are barred, and he says the press is showing solidarity that should have come sooner.
